name: Ammunition
description: Creates 20 Ultra-Light, 10 Light, or 5 Heavy Ammunition. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Iron allowing 1 Infusion, Steel 2 and Lead 3.

Creates 3 Ultra-Light, 2 Light, or 1 Heavy specialized Ammunition that can contain the contents of a Potion or Vial and deliver to a Target. An Attack with this Ammunition can only be delivered up to a maximum range equal to your Ammocraft skill at the time of Crafting. If the Ammunition hits a Creature, they are considered to have consumed it but gain a +2 Bonus to any Checks to avoid the effects.

name: Non-Lethal Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Ammunition with a layer of resin, causing the projectile to do half damage. If the creature reaches 0 health from this damage, they go unconscious instead of dying.

name: Silver Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Ammunition with the Silvered Property.

name: Blackened Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Ammunition with the Blackened Property.

name: Armor Piercing Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Ammunition with a hard tip to increase armor penetration, negating up to 3 Physical Mitigation.

name: Smokescreen Ammunition
description: Infuse unfinished Ammunition with an smokescreen charge. The projectile no longer deals damage, but explodes on contact and creates a field of smoke in a 2 Unit Radius that lasts until the end of your next turn. Creatures within the smoke are considered blind if they rely on vision that requires sight.

name: Explosive Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Ammunition with an explosive charge. The projectile no longer deals damage, but it explodes on impact dealing 1d12 Fire Splash Damage to Creatures within 1 Unit of your Target.

name: Shrapnel Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Ammunition with an explosive charge that disperses lead sharpnel. The Projectile no longer deals damage, but it explodes on impact dealing 3d4 Physical Splash Damage to creatures within 2 Units of your target. Each creature hit must make a Resilience Check against the damage taken after Mitigation or gain the Bleeding Condition.

name: Executioner Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Ammunition with cobalt metal, causing it to execute creatures hit if they have less health remaining than your Ammocraft skill at the time of Crafting.

name: Ammunition Chamber Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Ranged Weapon to add the Ammunition Capacity property, choosing how many Ammunition the weapon can fire before needing to be reloaded with a Free Action. You can choose between the following variants: [6 Ammunition Capacity/+1 Damage, 2 Ammunition Capacity/+2 Damage, 1 Ammunition Capacity/+4 Damage]
